title: Lexical canonicalization and role-quarantine for onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: When onboarding new models we observed intermittent chat framing failures and large profile delta noise caused by noncanonical role markers and exotic subtoken splits. This ticket adds a lightweight canonicalization pass to the onboarding pipeline plus a role_quarantine mode to safely ingest bundles with unknown role delimiters. The change aims to: 1) normalize role/system/user delimiters to a canonical ASCII envelope before profile generation; 2) detect and record tokenizer fingerprints so profile publishers include tokenizer-aware fingerprints; 3) quarantine messages with ambiguous subtoken boundaries so they do not skew performance/latency histograms or golden prompt sets; 4) add regressions and telemetry to catch regressions during pinning and rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Onboard pipeline applies canonical role delimiter mapping to all incoming sample prompts and stores the mapping in model metadata
Performance profile publisher includes a tokenizer_fingerprint string so downstream pinning uses both model and tokenizer identity
Role_quarantine flag prevents ambiguous messages from being used in latency/cost profile aggregation and is visible in console onboard logs
End-to-end onboarding of two internal test models (one with non-ASCII role markers, one with emoji role markers) completes without creating profile noise > 5% compared to baseline
Unit tests cover canonicalizer mapping rules and subtoken boundary heuristics; integration test added to onboarding CI pipeline
implementation_notes: Add a canonicalizer module under onboarding/lexical that maps common unicode role delimiters to "<|system|>", "<|user|>", "<|assistant|>" equivalents
Emit tokenizer_fingerprint = sha1(sorted(tokenizer_metadata)) in profile metadata and surface it to the model catalog
Introduce role_quarantine boolean in onboarding config; quarantined samples get tagged and excluded from prefix/KV cache warmup and profiling aggregation
Add a lightweight subtoken boundary probe: run 100 sample tokenizations and mark messages with >2% boundary splits as ambiguous
Profile publisher to record both token_count and canonicalized_token_count for parity checks
progress_updates: 2025-02-12 - Kickoff meeting: scoped canonicalizer rules (ASCII arrows, common unicode markers, caret-based markers). Assigned lexical module to Luca.
2025-02-18 - Prototype canonicalizer implemented. Found 12 delimiter variants in corpora; mapping table added. Early tests show reduced template mismatch errors on sample set A.
2025-02-24 - Added tokenizer_fingerprint output in profile publisher. Fingerprint calculation normalized (deterministic ordering) and stored in model metadata payload.
2025-03-01 - Role_quarantine implemented and wired to profile aggregation to exclude flagged samples. Integration test failing intermittently due to a race in sample tagging; investigating.
2025-03-04 - Race condition fixed (atomic tag write). Running full integration onboarding CI; manual verification started for two internal models.
